# Jobs & delivery
{: .no_toc }

Are the scheduled jobs and deliveries keeping up?
{: .fs-6 .fw-300 }

This screen is part of the **web Hub's Console** and isn't in the Linux, macOS, Windows, iOS or Android apps yet (specs OPEN-QUESTIONS #27).
{: .note }

| | |
|---|---|
| **Screen ID** | `OPS-05` |
| **Route** | `/ops/jobs` |
| **Where** | Operations › Jobs & delivery |
| **Who can use it** | operations.view |
| **Kind** | table |
| **Available in** | Web Hub only (Console M3 (web only)) |

## What's on this screen

| Element | What it is | Shows / does | Rules |
|---|---|---|---|
| Jobs | table | each scheduled job: schedule, last run, outcome, duration | outcome is inferred from logs until [G9 #46](https://github.com/CompositeCode/substratalapps.com/issues/46) records runs |
| Delivery | metric tiles | webhook and push queue depth, DLQ depth, failure rate | failures across subscriptions need [G8 #45](https://github.com/CompositeCode/substratalapps.com/issues/45); until then link WHK-03 per webhook |

## For developers

Loads: `GET /ops/jobs`

Every call sends `Substratal-Version: 1` to `https://api.substratalapps.com` (no `/v1` in the path). See [API versioning]({{ '/api/versioning/' | relative_url }}) and the [API reference]({{ '/api/reference/' | relative_url }}).
